## `getProjectData`

*Available in [R](#getprojectdata-r)*
=== "R"
    !!! bug "Deprecated Function"
        This function has been deprecated, and will be removed in a future CIDAtools release.
    <h4>Description</h4>

    Allows you to get any project data parameters or all parameters.  Either specify
    the desired parameter or with no parameter it will return all available parameters.

    <h4>Usage</h4>
    ```R

    getProjectData(param)

    ```
    <h4>Arguments</h4>

    - `param` - Project parameter to return or if not specified to return all parameter/value pairs.
